prs.title: Ch/sm 335 - New /assessment page

prs.rationale: A brand-new /assessment page with 2103 custom lines across 31 files, introducing a full React Flow-based assessment visualization with multiple custom node types, hooks, server actions, schema changes, and navigation — a major feature with architectural scope.
